title: LLMOps Engineer
description: Operationalize, fine-tune, serve, and monitor Large Language Models at production scale with optimal throughput, KV-cache management, and hardware utilization.

goal.objective: Engineer high-throughput inference infrastructure, distributed serving engines, LoRA fine-tuning pipelines, and safety guardrails for generative AI models.
career_pillars: GPU Cluster Utilization & Inference Cost Optimization

learn.summary: Master high-throughput LLM serving engines (vLLM, HuggingFace TGI), PagedAttention, KV-cache optimization, quantizations (AWQ, GPTQ), LoRA/QLoRA tuning, and GPU orchestration with Ray.
key_competencies: GPU Telemetry, Triton Inference Server & Ray Clusters

capstone_projects.title: Production LLM Inference Gateway with Semantic Caching & Dynamic Fallback
capstone_projects.description: Architect an enterprise LLM proxy supporting multi-provider cascading, embedding-based semantic prompt caching, automated rate-limiting, and cost tracking.

capstone_projects.title: Continuous LLM Evaluation, RAG Triad & Guardrails CI Pipeline
capstone_projects.description: Build an automated CI evaluation pipeline testing RAG pipeline hallucination rates, context relevance, answer accuracy, and toxic prompt defense benchmarks.

certifications: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
interview_focus: LLM Serving Optimization (PagedAttention, Continuous Batching, vLLM vs TGI vs TensorRT-LLM)
Quantization Methods (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF, FP8/INT4 Precision Tradeoffs)
Semantic Caching Mechanics & Vector Distance Threshold Calibration
RAG Evaluation Metrics (Context Precision, Context Recall, Faithfulness, Answer Relevance)
LLM Cost Optimization, Latency Budgets & Prompt Token Compression Techniques

certification_details.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
certification_details.note: Role-based ML engineering certification; review the current exam guide and experience requirements.

tree.name: Foundations: LLMs, MLOps, and the LLMOps Landscape
tree.description: Master foundational LLMOps principles: Understanding how generative AI architectures, non-deterministic outputs, and massive GPU inference footprints transform traditional MLOps.

children.name: MLOps Fundamentals for LLMs
children.description: Translate traditional MLOps to LLMOps: Adapting CI/CD, data versioning, containerization, and observability to token-based billing, prompt versioning, and generative evaluation.

resources.title: Machine Learning Engineering for Production (MLOps) Course 1 (DeepLearning.AI)

children.name: Core LLM Concepts & Architectures
children.description: Master LLM fundamentals: Decoder-only architectures, context length scaling, KV-cache mechanics, tokenization, autoregressive sampling (temperature, top-p), and hallucination roots.

children.name: LLMOps Lifecycle & Role Context
children.description: Navigate the LLMOps lifecycle: Prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), model routing, safety guardrails, and real-time monitoring.

children.name: Development Environment & Core LLM Tooling
children.description: Set up production LLM development environments: Python virtual environments, CUDA drivers, Ollama / vLLM local testbeds, and Git-based prompt versioning repositories.

children.name: LLM Ecosystem Overview: Models & Providers
children.description: Evaluate open-weight vs proprietary model ecosystems: Comparing GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro against open-weights models (LLaMA-3, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen) for cost, latency, and compliance.

resources.title: Hugging Face Hub: Discover & Share Models

tree.name: LLM Application Development & Prompt Engineering
tree.description: Develop enterprise LLM applications: Orchestration frameworks, structured outputs, semantic retrieval, and guardrail enforcement.

children.name: Prompt Engineering: Techniques & Best Practices
children.description: Engineer production-grade prompt templates: Systematic few-shot exemplars, Chain-of-Thought, XML/Markdown structured prompting, schema enforcement with Pydantic, and prompt version control.

children.name: LLM Application Orchestration & Frameworks
children.description: Build stateful LLM applications using LangChain, LlamaIndex, and LangGraph: Multi-step chains, cyclic graphs, agentic memory management, and asynchronous tool invocation.

children.name: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) Systems
children.description: Architect production RAG systems: Chunking strategies (recursive, semantic, window-based), embedding models (bge, text-embedding-3), vector stores (Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone), and similarity search.

children.name: Advanced RAG Techniques & Optimization
children.description: Optimize RAG retrieval: Hybrid search (dense vectors + BM25), reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), cross-encoder re-ranking (Cohere/BGE), contextual query compression, and hypothetical document embeddings (HyDE).

children.name: Application-Level Guardrails & Content Moderation (Development)
children.description: Implement programmatic guardrails: NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, and Llama-Guard to enforce output format validation, topic boundaries, PII redaction, and toxicity filtering.

children.name: Agentic LLM Systems & Tool Use
children.description: Deploy autonomous LLM agents: Function calling APIs, tool execution sandboxes, planning and reflection loops, human-in-the-loop approvals, and multi-agent coordination with AutoGen or CrewAI.

tree.name: LLM Experimentation, Evaluation & Versioning
tree.description: Establish rigorous experimentation, benchmarking, and automated evaluation frameworks for generative models and prompt variations.

children.name: Prompt, Model & Configuration Version Control
children.description: Version control prompts and system configurations: Using tools like Promptfoo, Langfuse, or Arize Phoenix to manage prompt diffs, track variables, and tie prompt commits to release tags.

children.name: LLM Experiment Tracking & Management
children.description: Track LLM experiments at scale: Logging token consumption, prompt variations, model versions, latency, and human ratings in Weights & Biases or MLflow.

children.name: LLM & RAG Evaluation: Metrics, Benchmarks & Automated Tools
children.description: Automate LLM evaluation: Model-based evaluation (LLM-as-a-judge), Ragas framework (Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, Context Recall, Context Precision), and automated benchmark suites (MMLU, GSM8K).

resources.title: Evaluating LLM Applications: A Comprehensive Guide (Weights & Biases)

children.name: Human-in-the-Loop Evaluation
children.description: Incorporate human-in-the-loop (HITL) evaluation: Designing annotation workflows in Argilla or Label Studio for expert domain review, golden test set curation, and preference data collection.

children.name: Data Curation & Annotation for LLMs
children.description: Curate instruction-tuning and alignment datasets: Filtering low-quality tokens, deduplication with MinHash, synthetic data generation with Self-Instruct, and structuring conversation schemas.

resources.title: Data for LLMs: Acquisition, Curation, and Governance (MIT)

tree.name: LLM Model Deployment & Serving
tree.description: Deploy and optimize high-throughput, low-latency LLM inference infrastructure across cloud and on-premises GPU clusters.

children.name: LLM Selection & Inference Optimization
children.description: Optimize LLM inference: KV-cache management (PagedAttention), continuous batching, model quantization (AWQ, GPTQ, GGUF), speculative decoding, and FlashAttention-2.

resources.title: Optimizing LLM inference speed for cost-effectiveness (Weights & Biases)

children.name: Customizing LLMs: Fine-tuning & Adaptation (PEFT)
children.description: Execute parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT): QLoRA with Hugging Face TRL (Transformer Reinforcement Learning), SFTTrainer, DeepSpeed ZeRO-3, and hyperparameter tuning for domain adaptation.

children.name: LLM Serving Infrastructure & API Gateways
children.description: Deploy production LLM serving engines: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, and TGI (Text Generation Inference) wrapped in OpenAI-compatible API schemas with Triton Inference Server.

resources.title: vLLM: A High-Throughput LLM Serving Engine

children.name: Dynamic Model Routing & Traffic Management
children.description: Implement intelligent model routing: Gateway proxies (LiteLLM, Portkey, Cloudflare AI Gateway) for automated fallbacks, semantic caching with Redis, load balancing, and rate limiting.

tree.name: Production Monitoring, Observability & A/B Testing
tree.description: Establish production observability, telemetry tracking, cost management, and safe rollout patterns for generative AI applications.

children.name: LLM Observability: Tracing, Logging & Metrics
children.description: Implement distributed LLM tracing: Instrumenting applications with OpenInference, Langfuse, or Phoenix to visualize complete execution traces, token latencies, and tool call payloads.

children.name: Performance Monitoring & Alerting
children.description: Monitor LLM operational health: Tracking Time-To-First-Token (TTFT), Inter-Token Latency (ITL), queue wait times, GPU memory saturation, and setting threshold alerts in Datadog/Prometheus.

children.name: LLM Data & Performance Drift Detection
children.description: Detect semantic drift and hallucination spikes: Embedding-based drift detection, monitoring topic shifts in user queries, tracking context retrieval failure rates, and flagging anomalous token patterns.

children.name: Cost Optimization & Resource Management
children.description: Manage and reduce LLM operational expenditure: Semantic caching of repeated queries, dynamic token pruning, model tiering (routing simple queries to mini models), and batch API utilization.

resources.title: How to Reduce Costs and Increase Performance of Your LLM Application (Genspark)

children.name: A/B Testing, Canary Releases & Rollbacks
children.description: Execute safe LLM deployments: Canary releases of new prompts or fine-tuned model checkpoints, shadow traffic evaluation, and automated rollback triggers on evaluation metric dips.

tree.name: Advanced LLM Security, Privacy & Compliance
tree.description: Harden LLM systems against adversarial attacks, protect sensitive user data, and ensure regulatory compliance.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications

children.name: Prompt Injection, Data Exfiltration & Jailbreak Defenses
children.description: Defend against prompt injection and jailbreaks: Dual-model input validation, delimiter token isolation, heuristic scanners (Rebuff, Vigil), and adversarial red-teaming.

children.name: Data Privacy, PII Handling & Compliance
children.description: Ensure enterprise data privacy: Real-time PII anonymization (Microsoft Presidio), HIPAA/GDPR data handling protocols, zero-data-retention API contracts, and on-premises inference.

resources.title: Anonymizing and Redacting Sensitive Data from LLM Prompts (Cognoscent)

children.name: Adversarial Testing & Red-Teaming LLMs
children.description: Conduct systematic LLM red-teaming: Automated fuzzing using Garak, testing for training data extraction vulnerabilities, system prompt leakage, and unauthorized tool execution.

children.name: LLM Bias, Fairness & Ethical AI Mitigation
children.description: Mitigate demographic bias and toxicity: Designing constitutional AI principles, evaluating representation across diverse user segments, and filtering harmful completions.

tree.name: Portfolio and Career Readiness
tree.description: Build an industry-standard LLMOps portfolio: Authoring technical case studies, contributing to open-source LLMOps tools, and presenting production deployment architectures.

children.name: LLMOps Engineer Portfolio Capstone Project
children.description: Build an enterprise LLMOps capstone system: Deploy a production-grade multi-tenant RAG platform featuring vLLM inference, hybrid search, semantic caching, Langfuse tracing, and automated Ragas evaluation CI/CD.

resources.title: Building a Production-Ready RAG System (Weights & Biases)

children.name: Crafting LLMOps Case Studies
children.description: Draft comprehensive LLMOps architecture case studies: Documenting latency optimizations, cost reduction strategies ($/1M tokens), evaluation metrics, and incident recovery playbooks.

children.name: Interview Preparation & Role Positioning
children.description: Master LLMOps technical interviews: System design of high-throughput LLM platforms, deriving KV-cache memory footprints, explaining LoRA mathematics, and solving live debugging scenarios.

resources.title: ML Engineering Topics and Certification Preparation (Google Cloud)
